subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 75)
source.subtopic: Add or subtract multiples of 10 from 0-50

show.line: Adding ten is easy! Twenty-three plus ten. The tens go up by one. Thirty-three! The ones stay the same.

rounds.prompt: Fourteen plus ten. What is the answer?
Three bundles of ten. Add two more bundles. Count all the sticks in tens.
rounds.praise: Fifty! Thirty plus twenty is fifty.

rounds.prompt: Forty take away ten. Say the answer.
Twenty-six plus twenty. What is the answer?

rounds.story: Kabelo has thirty-five marbles. He loses ten of them. How many marbles does he have left?

rounds.prompt: Keep adding ten. Twelve, twenty-two, thirty-two. What comes next?

hints: Adding ten makes the tens digit one bigger. The ones stay the same.
Count in tens from the number. Twenty-three, thirty-three.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I added one, not ten. Thirty-one plus ten is forty-one.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in tens together. Thirty-one, forty-one. Forty-one!

parent_line: Can add and take away tens from numbers up to 50.
